Vendored UMD assets from the published prettier@3.9.10 package via unpkg:
standalone.js, plugins/babel.js, plugins/estree.js, plugins/postcss.js.
Parser files are stored in this directory without the plugins/ prefix.
No code is fetched at runtime. Update all four files together.
